core.headline: 2-bed mid-terrace, Sheerness – Modern Method of Auction
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Mid-terrace house in Sheerness requiring modernisation, with two bedrooms, rear yard and no onward chain. Guide Price £150,000 plus buyer's reservation fee.
core.listing:
For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness requiring modernisation, offered with no onward chain. The property has mains gas central heating, a rear yard and on-street parking with no permit required.

The ground floor comprises a reception room. The first floor provides two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside, there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available with no permit required.

Station Terrace is located in Sheerness, ME12.

Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. Modern Method of Auction: the buyer pays a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, in addition to the purchase price; 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide.
